# Embracing You Therapy

> A Woodland Hills, CA-based therapy practice specializing in evidence-based CBT and ERP treatment for OCD, anxiety disorders, ADHD, and related conditions across the lifespan.

Embracing You Therapy offers specialized mental health services through a team of licensed psychologists and marriage and family therapists in Woodland Hills, California, with both in-person and online therapy options available throughout the state. The practice emphasizes cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and exposure and response prevention (ERP) for treating anxiety, obsessive-compulsive disorder, and other mental health conditions.

## Key Topics

- OCD Treatment
- Anxiety Therapy
- ERP (Exposure and Response Prevention)
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- ADHD Treatment
- Social Anxiety
- Emetophobia
- Trichotillomania
- Body Dysmorphic Disorder
- Online Therapy
- Child Therapy
- Couples Therapy
- Woodland Hills, CA
- Licensed Psychologists
- Marriage and Family Therapists

## Core Therapy Services

- [OCD Treatment](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/ocd-treatment): OCD treatment page explaining ERP therapy for intrusive thoughts and compulsions
- [Anxiety Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/anxiety-therapy): Anxiety therapy services for panic attacks and anxiety disorders
- [Social Anxiety Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/social-anxiety-therapy): Social anxiety disorder treatment using ERP in Woodland Hills
- [ADHD Treatment](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/adhd-treatment): ADHD treatment page offering therapy for attention deficit and task management
- [Child Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/child-therapy): Child therapy for OCD, ADHD, and anxiety disorders in Woodland Hills
- [Online Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/online-therapy): Online therapy services available throughout California for various conditions

## Specialized Treatment Programs

- [Body Dysmorphic Disorder Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/body-dysmorphic-disorder-therapy): BDD treatment page describing therapy for body image obsessions and compulsions
- [Emetophobia Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/emetophobia-therapy): Specialized emetophobia treatment for fear of vomiting in Woodland Hills
- [Trichotillomania Treatment](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/trichotillomania-treatment): Treatment for trichotillomania and body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRBs)
- [Perfectionism Therapy](https://embracingyoutherapy.com/therapy-for-perfectionism): Perfectionism therapy addressing anxiety and self-worth issues in California
